description: Réseau de transport routier national métropolitain is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Frédéric Rodrigo. National metropolitan road transport network with the reunited attributes of the various CERAM publications: Geometry Number of channels Road width Nature of track Authority responsible for maintenance The original datasets are: The dataset “Owner Authority” has been ignored, it brings nothing, the entire national road network belongs to the. Coverage: Frédéric Rodrigo. The portal shows the English title as "Metropolitan National Road Transport Network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Frédéric Rodrigo. Its keywords include routes-transports, transportation, routes-nationales. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GPKG. The listing shows 2019-12-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
